description: Crytek's Sponza atrium, the glTF version in KhronosGroup/glTF-Sample-Assets (fetched at a pinned commit by examples/sponza/fetch.mjs; not in the repository: Crytek's CRYENGINE Limited License Agreement), 262 thousand triangles in 103 primitives and 69 textures of 1024 x 1024: 363 MB of RGBA8 with their mips on the GPU.

The asset step packs it three times (helder.scene.gltf.Pack): its images as the file has them (PNG and JPEG, decoded when loaded), compressed to BC1/BC3 (desktops, and the web where WebGPU has texture-compression-bc or WebGL2 WEBGL_compressed_texture_s3tc) and to ASTC 4x4 (phones' GPUs); the program fetches the one the GPU samples (Device.supports). A sun with two shadow cascades, a prefiltered sky, HDR, bloom and ACES. The camera flies a loop through the atrium; drag or press a key to fly it yourself.

devices.device: A desktop GPU, BC (to be measured)

compare.what: three.js r170 with GLTFLoader on the same Sponza glTF (three.js' examples have no Sponza page)
compare.note: the .gltf, .bin and 69 PNG and JPEG images 50.2 MB, three.module.js 1.31 MB (0.69 MB minified) and GLTFLoader 0.11 MB; decoded on the GPU as RGBA8, 363 MB with mips, unless the textures are recompressed to KTX2 for its KTX2Loader (the Basis transcoder another 0.5 MB).
